why: Judges a pinned control against the content scrolling beneath it. Versus Setup's Start and Back live in a sticky bar (issue #668) that is drawn over the map cards and stock buttons by design; measured on the tree before issue #686, that alone produced 54 overlap readings with no defect behind any of them. A gate that failed on them would be switched off, or would push a fix toward un-pinning Start, which #668 measured as 1.73 screens of scrolling on a phone.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) does not fail scrolled content passing under a pinned action bar, but fails two pinned controls that overlap
